question: Sine bars are used when a high degree of accuracy less than _________ is needed for measuring angles.
solution:
The correct answer is __1 minute****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sine bars are used for measuring angles with a high degree of accuracy.__
 
• The accuracy achieved using a sine bar is generally less than 1 minute.
 
• Sine bars operate based on the principle of the sine rule.
 
• They are mainly used in tool rooms and inspection departments.
 
• To measure angles, sine bars require precision accessories such as gauge blocks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage:**
 
 
• Sine bars are primarily used for angular measurement and checking.
 
• They are often employed in conjunction with dial indicators for precise results.
 
 
 
• **Construction:**
 
 
• Sine bars are made of high-grade steel for durability and accuracy.
 
• They include cylindrical rollers at both ends.
 
 
 
• **Limitations:**
 
 
• The accuracy of sine bars is affected by incorrect alignment and surface imperfections.
 
• They are not suitable for measuring large angles.
